children: Australian shares are expected to open lower on Monday, with miners likely to be pressured by the recent weakness in copper prices, while investors brace for the possibility of a fifth interest rate hike this year on Tuesday.
The local share price index futures (YAPcm1) fell 0.05%, a 4-point discount to the underlying S&P/ASX 200 index
close. The benchmark rose 1.3% last week.
